== History & Background / Dossier ==
[[Gashimuu (world)|Gashimuu]] was settled around [[-2400]] by [[Vilani]] fleeing the [[Rule of Man]]. Like most such colonies, it regressed technologically, but not as far as many, and it regained jump capability around [[-80]].  A lot of heavy industry had already been placed on the next world out from [[Gashimuu (world)|Gashimuu]], a world inhabited by the [[Nenlat]], and as the years went by, this world finally overtook [[Gashimuu (world)|Gashimuu]] as the system [[mainworld]]. Inevitably, it became known as [[Deneb_(world)|Deneb]].

=== Imperial High / Landed Nobility ===
This is not a [[mainworld]] and does not have assigned nobles.
* Imperial Nobility may nevertheless possess grants to territories on this world that are part of their larger total Land Grants associated with titles and enfeoffments styled elsewhere.

=== World Starport ===
* ''[[Trans Galactic Starlines]]'', in partnership with [[Vilani]] [[megacorporation]] ''[[Zirunkariish]]'' have set-up alternate starports for ease of access and use with connecting in-system service provided to passengers; in the [[Deneb (world)|Deneb]] system, [[Gashimuu (world)|Gashimuu]] is used. This alternate starport has a ''[[Brubek's]]'' gastropub and a [[Medel's Mega Mart]].

=== World Economy ===
[[Vilani]] [[megacorporation]] [[Zirunkariish]] has offices here, including a major trading clearinghouse and both the [[Deneb Sector]] and [[Usani Subsector]] headquarters offices.

'''[[Deneb (system)|Deneb]] Co-Prosperity Development Trust:''' - This [[Zirunkariish]] subsidiary is committed to economic development of the [[Deneb (system)|Deneb system]] through direct investment and other projects anywhere within the [[Deneb (system)|Deneb system]], except on the mainworld of [[Deneb (world)|Deneb]].  It is headquartered on [[Gashimuu (world)|Gashimuu]].  Ownership: [[Zirunkariish]]--50%, [[Shiishuginsa family]]--25%, [[Sharurshid]] Trust--15%, [[House Zhunastu|Zhunastu family]]--10%.
